verses.en: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.
verses.pt: Em ti, Senhor, me refugio; nunca seja eu envergonhado; livra-me pela tua justiça!
verses.en_web: In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. A Psalm. Of David.> In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed; keep me safe in your righteousness.

verses.en: Bow down thine ear to me; deliver me speedily: be thou my strong rock, for an house of defence to save me.
verses.pt: Inclina para mim os teus ouvidos, livra-me depressa! Sê para mim uma rocha de refúgio, uma casa de defesa que me salve!
verses.en_web: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.
verses.en_bbe: Let your ear be turned to me; take me quickly out of danger; be my strong Rock, my place of strength where I may be safe.

verses.en: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.
verses.pt: Porque tu és a minha rocha e a minha fortaleza; pelo que, por amor do teu nome, guia-me e encaminha-me.
verses.en_web: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.
verses.en_bbe: For you are my Rock and my strong tower; go in front of me and be my guide, because of your name.

verses.en: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.
verses.pt: Tira-me do laço que me armaram, pois tu és o meu refúgio.
verses.en_web: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
verses.en_bbe: Take me out of the net which they have put ready for me secretly; for you are my strength.

verses.en: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.
verses.pt: Nas tuas mãos entrego o meu espírito; tu me remiste, ó Senhor, Deus da verdade.
verses.en_web: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Yahweh, God of truth.
verses.en_bbe: Into your hands I give my spirit; you are my saviour, O Lord God for ever true.

verses.en: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the LORD.
verses.pt: Odeias aqueles que atentam para ídolos vãos; eu, porém, confio no Senhor.
verses.en_web: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: I am full of hate for those who go after false gods; but my hope is in the Lord.

verses.en: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;
verses.pt: Eu me alegrarei e regozijarei na tua benignidade, pois tens visto a minha aflição. Tens conhecido as minhas angústias,
verses.en_web: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.
verses.en_bbe: I will be glad and have delight in your mercy; because you have seen my trouble; you have had pity on my soul in its sorrows;

verses.en: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.
verses.pt: e não me entregaste nas mãos do inimigo; puseste os meus pés num lugar espaçoso.
verses.en_web: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.
verses.en_bbe: And you have not given me into the hand of my hater; you have put my feet in a wide place.

verses.en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.
verses.pt: Tem compaixão de mim, ó Senhor, porque estou angustiado; consumidos estão de tristeza os meus olhos, a minha alma e o meu corpo.
verses.en_web: Have mercy on me, Yahweh, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.
verses.en_bbe: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in trouble; my eyes are wasted with grief, I am wasted in soul and body.

verses.en: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.
verses.pt: Pois a minha vida está gasta de tristeza, e os meus anos de suspiros; a minha força desfalece por causa da minha iniqüidade, e os meus ossos se consomem.
verses.en_web: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.
verses.en_bbe: My life goes on in sorrow, and my years in weeping; my strength is almost gone because of my sin, and my bones are wasted away.

verses.en: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.
verses.pt: Por causa de todos os meus adversários tornei-me em opróbrio, sim, sobremodo o sou para os meus vizinhos, e horror para os meus conhecidos; os que me vêem na rua fogem de mim.
verses.en_web: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
verses.en_bbe: Because of all those who are against me, I have become a word of shame to my neighbours; a cause of shaking the head and a fear to my friends: those who saw me in the street went in flight from me.

verses.en: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.
verses.pt: Sou esquecido como um morto de quem não há memória; sou como um vaso quebrado.
verses.en_web: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.
verses.en_bbe: I have gone from men's minds and memory like a dead man; I am like a broken vessel.

verses.en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
verses.pt: Pois tenho ouvido a difamação de muitos, terror por todos os lados; enquanto juntamente conspiravam contra mim, maquinaram tirar-me a vida.
verses.en_web: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.
verses.en_bbe: False statements against me have come to my ears; fear was on every side: they were talking together against me, designing to take away my life.

verses.en: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou art my God.
verses.pt: Mas eu confio em ti, ó Senhor; e digo: Tu és o meu Deus.
verses.en_web: But I trust in you, Yahweh. I said, “You are my God.”
verses.en_bbe: But I had faith in you, O Lord; I said, You are my God.

verses.en: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
verses.pt: Os meus dias estão nas tuas mãos; livra-me das mãos dos meus inimigos e dos que me perseguem.
verses.en_web: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.
verses.en_bbe: The chances of my life are in your hand; take me out of the hands of my haters, and of those who go after me.

verses.en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.
verses.pt: Faze resplandecer o teu rosto sobre o teu servo; salva-me por tua bondade.
verses.en_web: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.
verses.en_bbe: Let your servant see the light of your face; in your mercy be my saviour.

verses.en: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.
verses.pt: Não seja eu envergonhado, ó Senhor, porque te invoco; envergonhados sejam os ímpios, emudeçam no Seol.
verses.en_web: Let me not be disappointed, Yahweh, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.
verses.en_bbe: Let me not be shamed, O Lord, for I have made my prayer to you; let the sinners be shamed, and let their mouths be shut in the underworld.

verses.en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
verses.pt: Emudeçam os lábios mentirosos, que falam insolentemente contra o justo, com arrogância e com desprezo.
verses.en_web: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.
verses.en_bbe: Let the false lips be shut, which say evil against the upright, looking down on him in their pride.

verses.en: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
verses.pt: Oh! quão grande é a tua bondade, que guardaste para os que te temem, a qual na presença dos filhos dos homens preparaste para aqueles que em ti se refugiam!
verses.en_web: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!
verses.en_bbe: O how great is your grace, which you have put in store for your worshippers, and which you have made clear to those who had faith in you, before the sons of men!

verses.en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
verses.pt: No abrigo da tua presença tu os escondes das intrigas dos homens; em um pavilhão os ocultas da contenda das línguas.
verses.en_web: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.
verses.en_bbe: You will keep them safe in your house from the designs of man; in the secret of your tent will you keep them from angry tongues.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o Senhor, pois fez maravilhosa a sua bondade para comigo numa cidade sitiada.
verses.en_web: Praise be to Yahweh, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.
verses.en_bbe: May the Lord be praised, because he has made clear to me the wonder of his grace in a strong town.

verses.en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
verses.pt: Eu dizia no meu espanto: Estou cortado de diante dos teus olhos; não obstante, tu ouviste as minhas súplicas quando eu a ti clamei.
verses.en_web: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.
verses.en_bbe: And as for me, I said in my fear, I am cut off from before your eyes; but you gave ear to the voice of my prayer, when my cry went up to you.

verses.en: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: for the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
verses.pt: Amai ao Senhor, vós todos os que sois seus santos; o Senhor guarda os fiéis, e retribui abundantemente ao que usa de soberba.
verses.en_web: Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
verses.en_bbe: O have love for the Lord, all you his saints; for the Lord keeps safe from danger all those who are true to him, and gives the workers of pride their right reward.

verses.en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
verses.pt: Esforçai-vos, e fortaleça-se o vosso coração, vós todos os que esperais no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Put away fear and let your heart be strong, all you whose hope is in the Lord.
